value: The salt flats remain contested, with neither side showing signs of backing down. A Glimmer Coast Company caravan has reached the eastern ford, its guards outnumbering its cargo. The Tannerfolk claim another attack by the Hollow Spire Pirates, though the pirates have yet to confirm or deny. The Company's latest report calls the week profitable, as it always does. Those who can afford it are buying up salt at inflated prices; those who can't are heading inland. Rumors swirl of a new trade route forming, but no one has confirmed its existence.
